findings.title: Negative queryset slicing raises in Django
findings.body: When `enable_advanced_features` is set and `cursor.offset < 0`, the code slices the queryset with `queryset[start_offset:stop]` using a negative start. Django QuerySets do not support negative indexing and raise `ValueError` ("Negative indexing is not supported"). Any request with a cursor such as `0:-5:0` will crash with a 500 error. The comment claiming the ORM "properly handles negative slicing" is wrong.

findings.title: BasePaginator now passes negative offsets for prev cursors
findings.body: For prev cursors, `start_offset` is set to the raw `offset`, so a user-supplied negative offset (e.g. `123:-10:1`) reaches the queryset slice and raises `ValueError`. Previously this was also unvalidated, but the new code explicitly keeps negative offsets on the prev path. This affects every DateTimePaginator/Paginator endpoint, letting callers trigger 500s at will. Negative offsets should be rejected with `BadPaginationError`.

findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator cannot handle datetime key
findings.body: The endpoint orders by `-datetime`, but `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key` calls `math.floor`/`math.ceil` on the raw attribute. Those calls fail on datetime objects with a TypeError. `value_from_cursor` also returns the raw integer instead of converting it to a datetime, so cursor filtering compares a datetime column against a number. The optimized path therefore errors on any non-empty result set.

findings.title: organization_context.member may be None
findings.body: For superusers or staff who are not members of the organization, `organization_context.member` can be None. The `or` only short-circuits when `is_superuser` is true. Any other user without a membership row, such as staff, raises AttributeError and gets a 500.

findings.title: Feature intent is to read data "beyond normal pagination bounds"
findings.body: The code comments describe negative offsets as giving access to data beyond normal pagination bounds, justified by permissions being checked at the queryset level. Exposing an undocumented, user-controlled offset bypass behind a query flag is unsafe. It should be removed rather than shipped.

findings.title: No tests for new paginator or endpoint branch
findings.body: The PR adds `OptimizedCursorPaginator` and a new endpoint code path with no tests. Basic coverage would have caught the datetime and negative-slice failures.
